description: Implement the .khtml template compiler: a build-time tool that parses Pug-style indentation-based template files and emits C source code that writes HTML into a kern_buf_t. Includes expression interpolation, conditionals, loops, includes, extends/block layout inheritance, and auto-escaping.
steps: Create src/kern_tpl_parser.c - template parser. Tokenize .khtml files line by line tracking indentation depth. Produce an AST with node types: Element (tag + attrs + children), Text (literal), Interpolation (#{expr} -> escaped, !{expr} -> raw), Statement (- if/else/for), Include, Extend, Block, Doctype.

Create src/kern_tpl_codegen.c - C code generator. Walk the AST and emit C code that calls kern_buf_write/kern_buf_writef/kern_html_write_esc. For elements: open tag with attributes (handle dynamic {expr} attrs), recurse into children, close tag. For interpolation: emit kern_html_write_esc(buf, expr) for #{} and kern_buf_write(buf, expr) for !{}. For statements: emit verbatim C (if/for/while). For includes: emit a call to the included partial's render function. For extends/block: generate the layout call structure.

Create src/kern_html.c - HTML utilities used by generated template code. kern_html_escape(buf, str) for XSS-safe output. kern_html_tag_open(buf, tag, attrs...), kern_html_tag_close(buf, tag), kern_html_void_tag(buf, tag, attrs...) for self-closing tags (img, br, input, link, meta).

Create src/kern_tpl_compile.c - orchestrator that reads a .khtml file, parses it, generates C code, and writes it to the output path. Also handles discovering all templates in a views/ directory and compiling them all.
Create tests/test_tpl_parser.c - test parsing various .khtml snippets into correct AST nodes
Create tests/test_tpl_codegen.c - test that generated C code for sample templates is correct and compilable
Create tests/test_html.c - test HTML escaping (covers <, >, &, ", ' characters) and tag generation
Create a sample template file tests/fixtures/hello.khtml and verify the full pipeline: parse -> codegen -> compile -> execute -> correct HTML output
acceptance_criteria: Parser handles: tags with attributes, nested elements via indentation, #{expr} interpolation, - statements (if/else/for), | literal text, include, extend/block, doctype
Generated C code compiles without warnings under -Wall -Wextra
Auto-escaping prevents XSS: <script> in interpolation becomes <script>
Layout inheritance works: extend specifies parent, block fills regions
